user_request: Build an AI document intelligence platform using AWS. It should allow users to upload PDF documents, extract text using OCR, store documents securely, provide semantic search and question answering using RAG, support user authentication, and expose APIs for integration with other enterprise systems. Prefer reusable open-source solutions where appropriate, but ensure the selected components have suitable licenses and acceptable security/maturity.
normalized_request: Build an AWS-based AI document intelligence platform enabling PDF upload, OCR-based text extraction, secure storage, semantic search, and RAG-powered question answering with user authentication and enterprise APIs, using open-source components where feasible and ensuring license compliance and acceptable security/maturity standards.

execution_plan.objective: Break down the AI document intelligence platform into functional components: PDF upload/handling, OCR text extraction, secure document storage, semantic search indexing, RAG-based question answering, user authentication, and REST API layer.

Identify open-source and public ecosystem solutions for each component including OCR engines, vector databases, RAG frameworks, authentication systems, document storage, semantic search tools, and API frameworks that are AWS-compatible.

Assess candidate solutions against criteria: license compatibility (permissive/commercial viability), security maturity, production readiness, AWS integration support, and alignment with enterprise requirements.

Determine for each component whether to REUSE an existing open-source solution, ADAPT an existing solution with modifications, or BUILD custom functionality, providing justification based on evaluation results.

Create a detailed architectural blueprint showing component integration on AWS, including data flow, security boundaries, API contracts, deployment topology, and implementation roadmap with prioritized phases.
Validate the blueprint for technical feasibility, license compliance, security best practices, scalability constraints, and identify any gaps or risks requiring resolution before development.
